robots.name: Chopper C1-10P
robots.art_brief:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Armoured Souls individual robot game portrait. Generate ONE square 1:1 image of ONE complete source-faithful robot, not an original substitute.
Scene/backdrop: quiet charcoal-to-black industrial studio gradient, subtle dark floor and restrained low haze.
Style/medium: premium realistic industrial sci-fi hard-surface 3D rendering, believable metal, fine scratches and restrained paint wear, preserving source geometry and colours. Match the established Armoured Souls portrait collection.
Composition: three-quarter view, complete full body with head, all feet/legs and equipment contained in frame, centered at about 85% of square canvas with breathing room. Readable silhouette at 512px.
Lighting: neutral soft key, cool upper-right rim light, controlled cinematic contrast and subtle source-appropriate sensors.
Constraints: one character, no additional figures, no collage/grid, no text/captions, watermark, UI or border, no firing or explosions. Keep canonical proportions and anatomy; do not add humanoid arms to walkers or astromechs. Full-resolution square master for 512x512 WebP export.
Subject: Authentic Chopper C1-10P from Rebels: short weathered orange-and-grey flat-topped dome, compact cream-and-orange patched cylindrical astromech body, mismatched mechanical side legs and source feet, small extended articulated dome manipulators, recognizable grumpy sensor layout. Preserve short broad source proportions and rusty scuffed finish. No human arms or humanoid reconstruction.
Catalogue label for metadata only, do not render text: #105 slot 1 Chopper C1-10P.
robots.refinement_note: Apply only after the final loadout is equipped. Main-hand operations affect that item instance only; a second weapon copy stays unrefined. The shield receives only its listed Hone. No unverified weapon attribute is added.
robots.equipment_interpretation: Chopper C1-10P fills the mobile skirmisher role. Its source body and selected portrait are retained. Arena main/offhand allocations can use fitted mounts or tool adapters; extra limbs, integrated source weapons and alternate forms grant no additional slots or combat effects.
robots.combat_rationale: Sprinter tuning supports the short equipment role; balanced stance and a 20% yield threshold implement its pressure or survival priority. Range follows the equipped weapons at both stages.
robots.tuning_plan: Use the existing Generalist strategy tuning rules with the Sprinter Build_Focus and its free pool; equipment refinements do not replace robot tuning.
robots.design_basis: New arena build authored for this collection using supplied equipment prices, hand compatibility and verified refinement examples. Original source identity and final artwork remain authoritative for appearance.

One robot only. No text, logos, watermark, frame, interface, collage, firing, explosions or extra characters.
Subject: Original starship security robot with a broad heavy chassis, muscular hydraulic arms and short stout bipedal legs. Graphite-grey armour with faded ochre shoulder housings. Rectangular chest battery bay, reinforced knuckles and broad split-toe industrial boots. Grounded three-quarter stance with hands relaxed, all fingers and feet contained in frame. Practical worn retro-space construction, no human facial features.
